name: Define Domain Language
summary: Define a precise domain glossary and record only durable, consequential design decisions.
description: Define or repair shared domain language by reconciling stakeholder terms, code behavior, concrete scenarios, and durable decisions. Use when overloaded vocabulary or undocumented trade-offs make design and implementation ambiguous.
risk_reason: This skill defines a precise domain glossary and records only durable, consequential design decisions; it does not create a decision record for routine, reversible, or uncontested choices.
refuses: It does not put file paths, class names, or transient implementation detail into domain definitions.
It does not create a decision record for routine, reversible, or uncontested choices.
It does not erase disagreement or present inferred terminology as stakeholder-approved language.

operational.latency_reason: The skill defines a precise domain glossary and records only durable, consequential design decisions, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
